requirements.text: An admin dashboard lists privacy-safe user/workspace, plan/subscription, resource, and aggregate metadata without tenant-private destinations or visitor dimensions.
Authorized administrators can inspect aggregate workspace, user, subscription, revenue, resource, event, country, and client health.
Visitor insights expose privacy-safe aggregates without raw IPs, visitor hashes, destinations, or tenant-private dimensions.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every insight query requires the matching platform permission.
Desktop charts and mobile stacked summaries expose the same aggregate scope without horizontal overflow.

observedBehaviors: The administration overview shows platform totals and a time-series chart.
Country and client-dimension summaries appear below the chart.
The visitor view contains chart and summary regions for privacy-safe traffic analysis.
Platform metrics and chart regions stack vertically on mobile.
The mobile header replaces the desktop sidebar.
